How to Play

Run left / right (moving is free)
Jump to reach high shuttles
Lunge: quick dash + longer reach (or double-tap a direction)
Also (1P)
Clear: on time = fast punch; late = high clear
Smash: jump + hit a high shuttle; standing = flat drive
Drop just over the net; at the net = net shot
Net kill: smash a loose net shot near the tape
Serve: clear = long, drop = short
★ Special: fill the pink bar with good shots, then press
⚡Stamina (gold bar): moving is free, shots cost
💥Jump smash 12 · smash 9 · net kill 7 · special 10
🍃Punch 5 · drop / net 4 · clear / lift 2.5 · lunge 5 · jump 4
💤Stand still to recover; under 30% you are slower and weaker; at 0 no jump smash
⏱️Swing just before the shuttle reaches you, in front of you, for a Perfect!
🎯Mix clears and drops to move your opponent front and back
🔋Rest with clears when tired; save smashes for short lifts
